summary: Iteration 30: tested new Conselho Executivo Digital V2 (Council). Backend: 5/5 pytest pass covering GET /council/meeting (shape+integrations), POST /generate + cache idempotency, POST /approve + tasks creation, GET /council/tasks, POST /refresh (via test_generate_meeting_and_cache using refresh first), and regression on /api/goal. Frontend: full flow verified end-to-end on the admin account (meeting was already generated today, so verified persisted state; refresh-meeting-btn available). All required data-testids present and integrations pill shows 'brevemente'. Regression: /meta, /conselhos and /painel continue to load.
critical_code_review_comments: council.py Approve endpoint returns {ok:false, reason:'no_meeting'} with HTTP 200 when no meeting exists — consider 404 for stricter semantics; UI already handles it with a toast.

council.py _generate_meeting fires 3 director LLM calls in parallel + 1 brain call (~20-40s total). Consider adding a soft timeout/fallback for the LLM (ai_json) so a stuck upstream doesn't leave the user without any meeting.

council.py _run_director / _run_brain trust the LLM JSON shape without validation; if the LLM omits a key (e.g. 'estrategia' or 'kpis'), the UI still renders because of Array.isArray guards — good. But 'situacao' / 'foco_principal' could be null and the card would show blanks. Consider defensive defaults server-side.
council.py Cache key is (user_id, company_id, date-UTC). On the day boundary crossing UTC vs Europe/Lisbon (UTC+0/+1) this may regenerate at midnight local — acceptable for now, worth documenting.
Conselho.jsx (~270 lines) button has duplicate 'h-13' and 'h-12' classes on approve-strategy-btn — cosmetic only.
Conselho.jsx load() re-fetches tasks only when meeting.approved is true; fine. No dependency issues seen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, full approve flow verified)
